scripts.build: pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-ui build && pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-app build && pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-web typecheck
scripts.test:ui: pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-ui test && pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-app test:ui && pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-web test
scripts.test:web: pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-web test && cargo test --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p popular-agent-web
scripts.test:sites: pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-web build && cargo build --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p popular-agent-web && node tools/test-site-agent.mjs
scripts.test:resources: pnpm --filter @movie-hub/contract build && pnpm --filter @movie-hub/helper-agent-web build && cargo build --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p popular-agent-web && node --import ../../api/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs tools/test-agent-resources.mjs
